additionalStylePaths.description: Additional relative paths (from project root) to search for styles.css files with @import 'tailwindcss'

exclude.description: Projects to exclude from generated @source directives. A list of project names, globs, or tags (e.g. ['apps/*', '!apps/legacy', 'tag:scope:core']). Uses the same project matching syntax as Nx (findMatchingProjects).
